text: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD his God from the stomach of the fish,
"I called out of my trouble and distress to the LORD, And He answered me; Out of the belly of Sheol I cried for help, And You heard my voice.
"But [as for me], I will sacrifice to You With the voice of thanksgiving; I shall pay that which I have vowed. Salvation is from the LORD!"
So the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah up onto the dry land.
